name: Norbuprenorphine-3-glucuronide
summary: Norbuprenorphine-3-glucuronide (N3G) is a major active metabolite of the opioid modulator buprenorphine. It has affinity for the κ-opioid receptor (Ki = 300 nM) and the nociceptin receptor (Ki = 18 μM), but not for the μ- or δ-opioid receptors. Whether N3G acts as an agonist or antagonist of each of the former two respective sites has yet to be determined.

pharmacology.text: Norbuprenorphine-3-glucuronide (N3G) is a major active metabolite of the opioid modulator buprenorphine. It has affinity for the κ-opioid receptor (Ki = 300 nM) and the nociceptin receptor (Ki = 18 μM), but not for the μ- or δ-opioid receptors. Whether N3G acts as an agonist or antagonist of each of the former two respective sites has yet to be determined.

uses.en: It has no use of its own. It is of interest as one of the substances the body makes from buprenorphine.
uses.zh: 它本身沒有用途，之所以受到關注，是因為它是人體由丁基原啡因產生的代謝物之一。
uses.zhHans: 它本身没有用途，之所以受到关注，是因为它是人体由丁基原啡因产生的代谢物之一。

fact.en: Glucuronidation, attaching a sugar-like group, is how the body usually prepares a drug for disposal, but here the resulting molecule is still active at some receptors.
fact.zh: 葡萄糖醛酸化（接上類似糖的基團）通常是人體準備把藥物排出的方式，但在這裡，生成的分子在部分受體上仍具活性。
fact.zhHans: 葡萄糖醛酸化（接上类似糖的基团）通常是人体准备把药物排出的方式，但在这里，生成的分子在部分受体上仍具活性。
